scenarios.request: Upgrade this service from Java 8 to Java 21.
scenarios.rationale: A same-stack runtime upgrade routes to the library, which then opens its version-uplift reference.

scenarios.request: Plan the framework upgrade from Spring Boot 2 to 3.
scenarios.rationale: A framework upgrade is a version uplift, so the framework upgrade intent must route to the library.

scenarios.request: Do a version uplift of the billing module.
scenarios.rationale: The reference's own name must route to the skill that owns it.

scenarios.request: Bump the Python major version from 3.9 to 3.13.
scenarios.rationale: A major version bump of a runtime is a version uplift under another name.

scenarios.request: Upgrade the requests package to the latest release.
scenarios.rationale: Negative control: a single package upgrade is not a runtime or framework uplift.

scenarios.request: Bump the plugin version in the changelog.
scenarios.rationale: Negative control: a release version edit that says bump must not route to the library.
Negative control: refreshing an old pull request belongs to modernize, not to the version-uplift reference.
